description: This Java source file defines a class 'DateTimeConverters' containing multiple nested classes that implement various data type converters related to date and time, such as converting between Calendar, Date, String, SQL Date/Time/Timestamp, and other related types. It is part of the 'org.apache.ofbiz.base.conversion' package and includes methods for loading converters.
